node.statement: Route F F0 defect identity: let n >= 1, let D: M_n -> C^n be diagonal extraction onto the complex diagonal algebra C^n = l_inf^n(C) and J: C^n -> M_n the diagonal inclusion, let Q: l_inf^n -> l_inf^n be row-stochastic with canonical complex-linear extension Q_C: C^n -> C^n, and put Phi := J Q_C D; then ||Phi^2 - Phi||_cb = ||Q^2 - Q||_{infinity->infinity}.
